proof.criterion: Round 1's failure is cleared: the new-issue dialog keeps offering its own actions - Create, Cancel, and the duplicate refusal's Create anyway - once the related section fills, and a person reaches them by scrolling, not only a test by scrollIntoViewIfNeeded.

proof.command: source /legion/harness/env.sh && cd packages/dispatch && bun run build:web && bun e2e/run.ts -- bunx playwright test --config e2e/playwright.config.ts --project=chromium --repeat-each=3 e2e/create-issue-related.e2e.ts  (then a throwaway probe spec driving the same dialog at the three window sizes with the mouse wheel)
proof.observed: 12 passed (36.9s), the red row 3 of 3. By hand, with the project seeded so the check returns its three items and the typed title is a possible duplicate of all of them: the form now scrolls at every size (375x667 clientHeight 665 / scrollHeight 711; 667x375 373 / 643; 1280x720 622 / 642, the cap being the window less the wrapper's 6rem). Scrolling with the mouse wheel alone - no programmatic scroll - brings Create whole into the window (375x667: y 605.53-649.53 of 667; 667x375: 313.53-357.53 of 375; 1280x720: 643-687 of 720), pressing it produces the POSSIBLE_DUPLICATE refusal, and wheeling again brings `Create anyway` whole into view at each size, which files the issue (the page lands on /issues/CORE-5 at all three). The 1280x720 case named in round 1's evidence, where `Create anyway` stood 39 px below the fold, is cleared with it. No sideways scroll anywhere: scrollWidth equals clientWidth at all three sizes, and with a 200-character unbroken token in a listed item's title (373 = 373), so `overflow-y-auto` computing overflow-x to `auto` costs nothing.
proof.negativeControl: The two overflow classes are what clear it, measured in round 1 on this same surface: without them the dialog stands 712.53 px tall in a 667 px window with Create at 651.53-695.53, `Create anyway` at 723.53-767.53 after the refusal, and `document.scrollingElement.scrollHeight === clientHeight === 667` so nothing scrolls; the red row then reads `Create stands outside the 667px window: top 651.53125, bottom 695.53125`.
